text: hey inside of cart/editor there is the brushes and the wireframe outline that happen to be there when you are just mouse hovering around, and so i want you to link those coordinates of the map to the X Y Z that is in the app dock in the bottom [Image #1] right so that this [Image #2] or this [Image #3] or this [Image #4] and etc, any of the mouse postions it shows that as the position on the x y z please
resolution: Linked the editor world hover point into the bottom dock POS readout. WorldViewport now publishes rounded terrain-aware hover coordinates using the same ground/snap paths that drive map paint and placement ghosts, and BuildDock prefers those hover coordinates while the cursor is over the world before falling back to the selected piece. Added a small non-persisted external store so hover updates only rerender the dock instead of churning EditorState.
